en.p: A bag contains 40 balls, each of which is either white or black. When 2 balls are drawn from this bag at random at the same time, let $p$ be the probability of drawing 2 white balls, $q$ the probability of drawing 1 white ball and 1 black ball, and $r$ the probability of drawing 2 black balls. When $p=q$, find the value of $60r$. (Given that $p>0$.) [4 points]
